limitations: Physical Windows/Android/iOS GPU time and FPS remain unmeasured.
Charge thresholds and the added boss damage require human balance playtesting on target devices.

parallel_import_failures.detail: Native allocator abort; corrupted size vs. prev_size
Native segmentation fault while importing an original font

import_diagnostics.resolution: Serialize offline editor imports via editor/import/use_multiple_threads=false; runtime threaded loading is unchanged.
import_diagnostics.cause: Exact native cause not established. The upstream concurrent-font-import issue is a similar failure, not a confirmed diagnosis.

normal.implementation_stage: Measured immediately before the final zero-light-mask optimisation; conservative normal-route timings. The light-mask change was separately image-verified with zero changed channels.

environment.note: Manual updates; native particles/tweens frozen like the base audit. New charge/impact geometry remains active. Seeding excluded from CPU.
Manual updates; native particles/tweens frozen like the base audit. New charge/impact geometry remains active. Seeding excluded from CPU.

performance_method.renderer: Compatibility / llvmpipe, two software renderer threads
notes: Native particles/tweens frozen following the unchanged baseline audit; new charge/impact geometry active in the dense audit.
CPU update timing excludes engine-driven immediate draw callbacks. New pooled-sprite synchronization moves some painting work into the measured update.
Startup records first and subsequent scene loads in each process, without flushing the operating-system cache. Dense cases additionally record first-frame and warm-up maximum/p95.
The original generic stat keys end in _ms even for draw_calls; draw-call values are counts.
Software host scheduling and rasterization vary; no physical-device FPS or GPU-time claim is made.

playable_archive.note: Rebuilt container after workspace cleanup. Runtime file bytes match the tested commit; ZIP timestamps may differ from the archive used for the recorded fresh-import run.
